text: 马克松可以告诉你：Brotherhood－兄弟会、Mathia－玛蒂雅、Cabbot－卡波特、Vree－弗蕾、Library－图书馆、Rhombus－隆勃斯、Elder－最高元老、Elders－元老、Initiates－新兵、Scribes－研究员、Knights－骑士、Paladins－游侠、Hub－哈勃、Butch－布奇、Traders－远足商会、Merchants－水商队、Disks－磁碟、Player－读碟机、Roger－罗杰、Exodus－大迁徙、Army－军队、Cathedral－大教堂、Angel's－洛杉矶、Gangs－帮派、Adytum－内城区、Claw－死亡爪、Harris－哈里斯、Maxson－马克松、Angels－洛杉矶、Boneyard－晒骨场、Master－主教、War－大战、Caravans－远足商队、Chip－芯片。
source_text: 马克松可以告诉你：Brotherhood－兄弟会、Mathia－玛蒂雅、Cabbot－卡波特、Vree－弗蕾、Library－图书馆、Rhombus－隆勃斯、Elder－最高元老、Elders－元老、Initiates－新兵、Scribes－研究员、Knights－骑士、Paladins－游侠、Hub－哈勃、Butch－布奇、Traders－远足商会、Merchants－水商队、Disks－磁碟、Player－读碟机、Roger－罗杰、Exodus－大迁徙、Army－军队、Cathedral－大教堂、Angel's－洛杉矶、Gangs－帮派、Adytum－内城区、Claw－死亡爪、Harris－哈里斯、Maxson－马克松、Angels－洛杉矶、Boneyard－晒骨场、Master－主教、War－大战、Caravans－远足商队、Chip－芯片。

text: You see General Maxson.
source_text: You see General Maxson.

text: What's the Brotherhood really about?
source_text: What's the Brotherhood really about?

text: I'll bet you know a lot of the history behind the Brotherhood.
source_text: I'll bet you know a lot of the history behind the Brotherhood.

text: Heard any good rumors?
source_text: Heard any good rumors?

text: I have some information to report.
source_text: I have some information to report.

text: That's all. Thanks.
source_text: That's all. Thanks.

text: Hello, youngster. Cabbot said you wanted to talk. Look I'm uh . . . # I'm pretty stacked up right now, so I'll uh . . . I'll help you out as long # as you don't start flappin' your gums too much. You know, outsiders are like that, # always jawin' . . . Hehehe. Kinda like me, huh?
source_text:
Hello, youngster. Cabbot said you wanted to talk. Look I'm uh . . .
 # I'm pretty stacked up right now, so I'll uh . . . I'll help you out as long
 # as you don't start flappin' your gums too much. You know, outsiders are like that,
 # always jawin' . . . Hehehe. Kinda like me, huh?

text: Outsiders? What do you mean by that?
source_text: Outsiders? What do you mean by that?

text: How 'bout a few questions then?
source_text: How 'bout a few questions then?

text: I can't. I just moderate these endless damn meetings. There's four Elders, # and me, you see? I break up fights and tie votes. Now, if all four vote to pick our # noses while an army rolls in here and kicks our collective butt, there's not a helluva # lot I can do about it.
source_text:
I can't. I just moderate these endless damn meetings. There's four Elders,
 # and me, you see? I break up fights and tie votes. Now, if all four vote to pick our
 # noses while an army rolls in here and kicks our collective butt, there's not a helluva
 # lot I can do about it.

text: Oh, well.
source_text: Oh, well.

text: That stinks. Why don't you do something?
source_text: That stinks. Why don't you do something?

text: Tradition. It's hard to change our ways. Now, maybe if the Elders had some real info, they'd get off their brains and do something.
source_text: Tradition. It's hard to change our ways. Now, maybe if the Elders had some real info, they'd get off their brains and do something.

text: An Initiate not born here. You're the first Outsider we've let join in # a long, long time. Well, near on twenty years now.
source_text:
An Initiate not born here. You're the first Outsider we've let join in
 # a long, long time. Well, near on twenty years now.

text: Why me?
source_text: Why me?

text: I'm flattered. How about some of those questions now?
source_text: I'm flattered. How about some of those questions now?

text: Because we need to do something. An army's gatherin', Hub-caravans are # disappearin', and our scouts sure as hell ain't gettin' the job done. # So the Elders actually did something once and figured the right # Outsider might have something to offer. That Outsider is you... We hope.
source_text:
Because we need to do something. An army's gatherin', Hub-caravans are
 # disappearin', and our scouts sure as hell ain't gettin' the job done.
 # So the Elders actually did something once and figured the right
 # Outsider might have something to offer. That Outsider is you... We hope.

text: What army?
source_text: What army?

text: What about these missing caravans?
source_text: What about these missing caravans?

text: Hmm. I guess there are some more things I need to ask then.
source_text: Hmm. I guess there are some more things I need to ask then.

text: What's the problem with the scouts?
source_text: What's the problem with the scouts?

text: I have some info you might want.
source_text: I have some info you might want.

text: When we heard about the missing caravans, we sent out a few # scouts east and the north. The ones who went north never returned. One came # back from the east. He talked about a score of strange beings, all muscle # with burnin' eyes. The Elder's aren't doin' squat, but I'm getting ready # just the same.
source_text:
When we heard about the missing caravans, we sent out a few
 # scouts east and the north. The ones who went north never returned. One came
 # back from the east. He talked about a score of strange beings, all muscle
 # with burnin' eyes. The Elder's aren't doin' squat, but I'm getting ready
 # just the same.

text: Twenty isn't an army. Why are you worried?
source_text: Twenty isn't an army. Why are you worried?

text: Sounds like your guy baked in the sun too long.
source_text: Sounds like your guy baked in the sun too long.

text: I'll do what I can.
source_text: I'll do what I can.

text: Did he say where to the east?
source_text: Did he say where to the east?

text: I have some info you might want.
source_text: I have some info you might want.

text: They may or may not be good scouts, but don't question # the truthfulness of my men. We can revoke your Initiate status at any time.
source_text:
They may or may not be good scouts, but don't question
 # the truthfulness of my men. We can revoke your Initiate status at any time.

text: Sounds like you need me more than I need you.
source_text: Sounds like you need me more than I need you.

text: Sorry.
source_text: Sorry.

text: That's it. I warned the Elders that bringin' in an Outsider could be trouble. (shouting aside) Guards! There's an Initiate here who needs some quiet time to discover some manners.
source_text: That's it. I warned the Elders that bringin' in an Outsider could be trouble. (shouting aside) Guards! There's an Initiate here who needs some quiet time to discover some manners.

text: You're an Outsider, but I expect you to learn our ways. I'll be watching. Now, ask your questions.
source_text: You're an Outsider, but I expect you to learn our ways. I'll be watching. Now, ask your questions.

text: Good. Anything else you need to ask?
source_text: Good. Anything else you need to ask?

text: Deep in the mountains. He couldn't be more specific.
source_text: Deep in the mountains. He couldn't be more specific.

text: Too bad. Can I ask you a few more questions?
source_text: Too bad. Can I ask you a few more questions?

text: What about to the north?
source_text: What about to the north?

text: Go ahead.
source_text: Go ahead.

text: Yeah, Fire away.
source_text: Yeah, Fire away.

text: Sure.
source_text: Sure.

text: Shoot.
source_text: Shoot.

text: I got a gut feeling there's a small force in the east and # a much bigger one in the north. The Elders are collecting dust because # none of the scouts returned from the north. I can't do anything but watch.
source_text:
I got a gut feeling there's a small force in the east and
 # a much bigger one in the north. The Elders are collecting dust because
 # none of the scouts returned from the north. I can't do anything but watch.

text: Well, I'll do what I can.
source_text: Well, I'll do what I can.

text: Why don't you do something?
source_text: Why don't you do something?

text: I think I'm in a bit over my head. Count me out.
source_text: I think I'm in a bit over my head. Count me out.

text: I have some info on that.
source_text: I have some info on that.

text: Well the Merchants from the Hub told us a bunch of caravans # disappeared on their way up north. I think there's an army in the mountains, # but the Elders, well, they don't want to act until they're sure.
source_text:
Well the Merchants from the Hub told us a bunch of caravans
 # disappeared on their way up north. I think there's an army in the mountains,
 # but the Elders, well, they don't want to act until they're sure.

text: Where did they disappear?
source_text: Where did they disappear?

text: Aren't you the High Elder? Why don't you do something?
source_text: Aren't you the High Elder? Why don't you do something?

text: Didn't you do anything?
source_text: Didn't you do anything?

text: I have some info on that.
source_text: I have some info on that.

text: The word I got was that the caravans disappeared around the # southern tip of the mountains to the east. I imagine the Hub merchants can probably # tell you more.
source_text:
The word I got was that the caravans disappeared around the
 # southern tip of the mountains to the east. I imagine the Hub merchants can probably
 # tell you more.

text: Thanks. I've got some more questions, if that's okay.
source_text: Thanks. I've got some more questions, if that's okay.

text: Thanks. I'll talk to you later.
source_text: Thanks. I'll talk to you later.

text: I have some info on that.
source_text: I have some info on that.

text: See you around, Initiate. You're not so bad...for an Outsider.
source_text: See you around, Initiate. You're not so bad...for an Outsider.

text: Goodbye, Initiate.
source_text: Goodbye, Initiate.

text: Goodbye!
source_text: Goodbye!

text: I grew up too isolated here. Can you imagine spending your whole life inside one small place, then having to go out into the world?
source_text: I grew up too isolated here. Can you imagine spending your whole life inside one small place, then having to go out into the world?

text: Well, as a matter a fact . . .
source_text: Well, as a matter a fact . . .

text: I guess I'm destined to be your scout, then.
source_text: I guess I'm destined to be your scout, then.

text: So because they didn't get out, I get to do your dirty work. Forget it.
source_text: So because they didn't get out, I get to do your dirty work. Forget it.

text: Then you understand the problem. To survive, we need someone who knows the outside. Like you.
source_text: Then you understand the problem. To survive, we need someone who knows the outside. Like you.

text: Ok, I'll do it.
source_text: Ok, I'll do it.

text: I've got my own problems. I pass.
source_text: I've got my own problems. I pass.

text: Well . . . with what I guess is coming, we don't have time for anyone # who's gonna . . . not contribute. Now, you either work with us, or you take a hike.
source_text:
Well . . . with what I guess is coming, we don't have time for anyone
 # who's gonna . . . not contribute. Now, you either work with us, or you take a hike.

text: Well, if you put it that way, I'm in.
source_text: Well, if you put it that way, I'm in.

text: Looks like a nice day for a stroll.
source_text: Looks like a nice day for a stroll.

text: Your choice. Hope you can live with it.
source_text: Your choice. Hope you can live with it.

text: What? It's who we are and what we live for. It's ideals. As you spend # more time with us, hopefully, you'll understand.
source_text:
What? It's who we are and what we live for. It's ideals. As you spend
 # more time with us, hopefully, you'll understand.

text: Yeah, but what do you actually do?
source_text: Yeah, but what do you actually do?

text: I'm not too sure about this.
source_text: I'm not too sure about this.

text: Our main goal is to survive. The Scribes copy old plans for weapons or design new ones, and the Knights make the guns from 'em. Most guns come from us.
source_text: Our main goal is to survive. The Scribes copy old plans for weapons or design new ones, and the Knights make the guns from 'em. Most guns come from us.

text: You trade the weapons to the Hub?
source_text: You trade the weapons to the Hub?

text: That's all you do?
source_text: That's all you do?

text: Makes sense. There's a couple of other things I need to ask.
source_text: Makes sense. There's a couple of other things I need to ask.

text: That's the way we get our supplies.
source_text: That's the way we get our supplies.

text: Okay, I get it. There's a couple of other things I need to ask.
source_text: Okay, I get it. There's a couple of other things I need to ask.

text: Okay. I need to get going now, though.
source_text: Okay. I need to get going now, though.

text: Guess I'm not too sure about this.
source_text: Guess I'm not too sure about this.

text: All? It's damn important. It's critical to our survival.
source_text: All? It's damn important. It's critical to our survival.

text: Whatever. I need to ask a few more questions.
source_text: Whatever. I need to ask a few more questions.

text: Yeah, well, it's stupid.
source_text: Yeah, well, it's stupid.

text: Ok, thanks. I really should be going now, though.
source_text: Ok, thanks. I really should be going now, though.

text: Then you need to get sure. Because being unsure is bound to get you killed.
source_text: Then you need to get sure. Because being unsure is bound to get you killed.

text: The more I know, the more sure I'll be.
source_text: The more I know, the more sure I'll be.

text: Look I don't have time for a story that long right now. Here. All of us grew up on this.
source_text: Look I don't have time for a story that long right now. Here. All of us grew up on this.

text: There's rumors concerning the missing caravans in the Hub, as well as the strange army brewing in the eastern mountains.
source_text: There's rumors concerning the missing caravans in the Hub, as well as the strange army brewing in the eastern mountains.

text: Ok.
source_text: Ok.

text: What army?
source_text: What army?

text: What about these missing caravans?
source_text: What about these missing caravans?

text: I have some info on that.
source_text: I have some info on that.

text: I don't take stock in rumors.
source_text: I don't take stock in rumors.

text: Ahh . . . Hello again, Initiate. Are things going well?
source_text: Ahh . . . Hello again, Initiate. Are things going well?

text: Pretty good. Can I ask you a few more questions?
source_text: Pretty good. Can I ask you a few more questions?

text: Well, actually, it sucks.
source_text: Well, actually, it sucks.

text: Yes, thanks, but I gotta go.
source_text: Yes, thanks, but I gotta go.

text: I'm sorry we're not what you're used to but you could show a little self-discipline.
source_text: I'm sorry we're not what you're used to but you could show a little self-discipline.

text: Sorry. Can I ask you a few more questions?
source_text: Sorry. Can I ask you a few more questions?

text: Why? This place is a joke?
source_text: Why? This place is a joke?

text: I have to get going. Bye.
source_text: I have to get going. Bye.

text: What the hell do you want now?
source_text: What the hell do you want now?

text: I want to know why an idiot is in charge here.
source_text: I want to know why an idiot is in charge here.

text: I need to ask a few more questions.
source_text: I need to ask a few more questions.

text: Never mind, thanks.
source_text: Never mind, thanks.

text: Whaddya got?
source_text: Whaddya got?

text: Sorry, I didn't really have anything.
source_text: Sorry, I didn't really have anything.

text: The Hub caravans are being taken by huge, green mutants. They're gathering an army.
source_text: The Hub caravans are being taken by huge, green mutants. They're gathering an army.

text: There's a large army to the north controlled by someone called the Master.
source_text: There's a large army to the north controlled by someone called the Master.

text: You've seen 'em? This might actually get the Elders to do something. # I'm gonna get on this, thanks!
source_text:
You've seen 'em? This might actually get the Elders to do something.
 # I'm gonna get on this, thanks!

text: Uh . . . What's he plan to do with this . . . army of his?
source_text: Uh . . . What's he plan to do with this . . . army of his?

text: He plans to take over the Brotherhood, the Hub, Junktown . . . everyone.
source_text: He plans to take over the Brotherhood, the Hub, Junktown . . . everyone.

text: How much you paying for this information?
source_text: How much you paying for this information?

text: Finally! Well this'll get the Elders  off their butts. We'll fortify the Fortress and surprise those damn mutants.
source_text: Finally! Well this'll get the Elders  off their butts. We'll fortify the Fortress and surprise those damn mutants.

text: No! You don't understand. They are turning people into mutants and adding them to their army.
source_text: No! You don't understand. They are turning people into mutants and adding them to their army.

text: Okay.
source_text: Okay.

text: So?
source_text: So?

text: So, by the time they get here, they'll be unstoppable. And they have advanced weapons, like yours. You don't stand a chance.
source_text: So, by the time they get here, they'll be unstoppable. And they have advanced weapons, like yours. You don't stand a chance.

text: Well, okay. Maybe digging in is the right thing.
source_text: Well, okay. Maybe digging in is the right thing.

text: So what's your alternative?
source_text: So what's your alternative?

text: Help me attack the Master's base. I know where it is.
source_text: Help me attack the Master's base. I know where it is.

text: Hmmm. Not a bad plan. Tell you what, let me go try and beat it into the Elders. No guarantees, but I'll try.
source_text: Hmmm. Not a bad plan. Tell you what, let me go try and beat it into the Elders. No guarantees, but I'll try.

text: Then get out. I have work to do.
source_text: Then get out. I have work to do.

text: Pretty interesting set of priorities and loyalties you got there.
source_text: Pretty interesting set of priorities and loyalties you got there.

text: Loyal to me. 500 in Hub script. Take it or leave it.
source_text: Loyal to me. 500 in Hub script. Take it or leave it.

text: Oh . . . yeah. Okay, I'll tell you. He plans to take over everyone and everything.
source_text: Oh . . . yeah. Okay, I'll tell you. He plans to take over everyone and everything.

text: I'll take it. We need the information to save lives.
source_text: I'll take it. We need the information to save lives.

text: Pretty simple. He's changing humans into mutants and he's got advanced weapons. He plans to take over everything.
source_text: Pretty simple. He's changing humans into mutants and he's got advanced weapons. He plans to take over everything.

text: Well, if he does, hope you find a place to use your scripts.
source_text: Well, if he does, hope you find a place to use your scripts.

text: Well, how about nothing! Guards, kick this fool out. By God! # We'll defend the Brotherhood without your damn help.
source_text:
Well, how about nothing! Guards, kick this fool out. By God!
 # We'll defend the Brotherhood without your damn help.

text: What do you think you're doing? Put that down. Put it down now!
source_text: What do you think you're doing? Put that down. Put it down now!

text: That's it. Guards! Take this idiot away!
source_text: That's it. Guards! Take this idiot away!

text: Hey, hey, hey, hey! Hold on now. Stop that. Stop it right now!
source_text: Hey, hey, hey, hey! Hold on now. Stop that. Stop it right now!

text: Like I said...
source_text: Like I said...

text: I said...
source_text: I said...

text: I am not in the habit of repeating myself. So open your ears.
source_text: I am not in the habit of repeating myself. So open your ears.

text: Look I told ya' already. It's not my fault if you didn't get it.
source_text: Look I told ya' already. It's not my fault if you didn't get it.

text: That's where you are. You want the long version, go talk to Vree.
source_text: That's where you are. You want the long version, go talk to Vree.

text: Mathia's my assistant.
source_text: Mathia's my assistant.

text: Oh, he's a good kid, even if he does want to be a Scribe.
source_text: Oh, he's a good kid, even if he does want to be a Scribe.

text: Vree's the head Scribe.  She's usually in the Library, she always likes to talk.
source_text: Vree's the head Scribe.  She's usually in the Library, she always likes to talk.

text: We keep weapon specs and history there.
source_text: We keep weapon specs and history there.

text: Rhombo's been here a long time. A bit stiff, but a helluva soldier.
source_text: Rhombo's been here a long time. A bit stiff, but a helluva soldier.

text: Hehehe. A fine, handsome, upstanding man. The High Elder position is to mediate the meetings between the Elders. You see, two years ago I got talked into it. If I'd of known then...
source_text: Hehehe. A fine, handsome, upstanding man. The High Elder position is to mediate the meetings between the Elders. You see, two years ago I got talked into it. If I'd of known then...

text: Well you see there's four of them and that's about all they can ever agree on. They can't even agree if they want to piss, much less pick a pot to piss in.
source_text: Well you see there's four of them and that's about all they can ever agree on. They can't even agree if they want to piss, much less pick a pot to piss in.

text: Well that's what you are. Initiates train and learn to become knights or scribes.
source_text: Well that's what you are. Initiates train and learn to become knights or scribes.

text: Well, Scribes copy down the weapon specs. We've got information all the way back to # my granddad. Sometimes a scribe comes up with a new idea for a weapon. Hehehe. Doesn't happen too often. # They all answer to Vree.
source_text:
Well, Scribes copy down the weapon specs. We've got information all the way back to
 # my granddad. Sometimes a scribe comes up with a new idea for a weapon. Hehehe. Doesn't happen too often.
 # They all answer to Vree.

text: The Knights make the weapons. And when he's good enough, a Knight can advance to become a Paladin and then an Elder and so forth. Right now Rhombus is the head of the Knights.
source_text: The Knights make the weapons. And when he's good enough, a Knight can advance to become a Paladin and then an Elder and so forth. Right now Rhombus is the head of the Knights.

text: Paladins are in charge of all security and outside activities. I remember tradin' with the Hub, goin' on scouting missions for the Elders. Ah man, those ware a good times.
source_text: Paladins are in charge of all security and outside activities. I remember tradin' with the Hub, goin' on scouting missions for the Elders. Ah man, those ware a good times.

text: The Hub's down to the southeast. They trade us food and things for the weapons we make here. Now if you're ever down there, you talk to Butch Harris.
source_text: The Hub's down to the southeast. They trade us food and things for the weapons we make here. Now if you're ever down there, you talk to Butch Harris.

text: Butch is the head of the Far Go Traders. He's a little slimy, but he's not a total waste. Unlike those Water Merchants. Bunch of damn vultures, all of 'em.
source_text: Butch is the head of the Far Go Traders. He's a little slimy, but he's not a total waste. Unlike those Water Merchants. Bunch of damn vultures, all of 'em.

text: They're the main ones we trade with. Not totally trustworthy, but not as bad as the others.
source_text: They're the main ones we trade with. Not totally trustworthy, but not as bad as the others.

text: You can't trust them. A few years ago, they offered us Water for a huge stockpile of weapons. We told them no, and you know what they did? Sent in thieves to steal the weapons! We caught 'em, but the Elders voted down going to the Hub to teach the merchants a lesson.
source_text: You can't trust them. A few years ago, they offered us Water for a huge stockpile of weapons. We told them no, and you know what they did? Sent in thieves to steal the weapons! We caught 'em, but the Elders voted down going to the Hub to teach the merchants a lesson.

text: Holo discs? Hmm? I haven't seen those in a while.
source_text: Holo discs? Hmm? I haven't seen those in a while.

text: Vree has it someplace in the Library.
source_text: Vree has it someplace in the Library.

text: Roger Maxson huh? Well he led our people here in the great Exodus, started the Brotherhood from scratch. Quite a leader.
source_text: Roger Maxson huh? Well he led our people here in the great Exodus, started the Brotherhood from scratch. Quite a leader.

text: Well that was when my granddad, Roger Maxson, led his soldiers here and started the Brotherhood. He never mentioned where they came from, but it  doesn't really matter, 'cause...well, this is our home now.
source_text: Well that was when my granddad, Roger Maxson, led his soldiers here and started the Brotherhood. He never mentioned where they came from, but it  doesn't really matter, 'cause...well, this is our home now.

text: Well I believe there's an army massing to the north and in the mountains to the east, but I don't have any way to prove it. The Elders, they won't even listen.
source_text: Well I believe there's an army massing to the north and in the mountains to the east, but I don't have any way to prove it. The Elders, they won't even listen.

text: A bunch of religious whackos, if you ask me. I think their main church is in the Boneyard.
source_text: A bunch of religious whackos, if you ask me. I think their main church is in the Boneyard.

text: Well I don't know a lot. There's a bunch of gangs around there, as well as Adytum and the Children of the Cathedral. Not much else. It's pretty damn desolate.
source_text: Well I don't know a lot. There's a bunch of gangs around there, as well as Adytum and the Children of the Cathedral. Not much else. It's pretty damn desolate.

text: 当我们听说了失踪商队的事情后，我们向东面和北面派出了一些侦察兵。北面的一去不复返。一个士兵从东面回来了。他谈到了二十个奇怪的生物，浑身肌肉，眼里放火。元老们无动于衷，我却立即开始准备起来。
source_text: 当我们听说了失踪商队的事情后，我们向东面和北面派出了一些侦察兵。北面的一去不复返。一个士兵从东面回来了。他谈到了二十个奇怪的生物，浑身肌肉，眼里放火。元老们无动于衷，我却立即开始准备起来。

text: 二十个不是一支军队，你担心什么？
source_text: 二十个不是一支军队，你担心什么？

text: 听起来，你的人在地洞里呆惯了，去外面太长时间晒晕了。
source_text: 听起来，你的人在地洞里呆惯了，去外面太长时间晒晕了。

text: 我将尽力而为。
source_text: 我将尽力而为。

text: 他说过是东面哪里了吗？
source_text: 他说过是东面哪里了吗？

text: 我有一些信息你可能需要。
source_text: 我有一些信息你可能需要。

text: 他们也许不是好的侦察兵，但是不要质疑我士兵的忠诚。我们可以随时吊销你的会籍。
source_text: 他们也许不是好的侦察兵，但是不要质疑我士兵的忠诚。我们可以随时吊销你的会籍。

text: 听起来，你们需要我比我需要你多的多。
source_text: 听起来，你们需要我比我需要你多的多。

text: 对不起。
source_text: 对不起。

text: 不出所料，我提醒过元老们引进外来者将会带来麻烦。【一旁呼喊声】警卫！这里有个新加入者需要一些时间来学会礼貌。
source_text: 不出所料，我提醒过元老们引进外来者将会带来麻烦。【一旁呼喊声】警卫！这里有个新加入者需要一些时间来学会礼貌。

text: 你是个外来者，但是我希望你能学会我们的行为方式。我将注意你。现在，可以提问了。
source_text: 你是个外来者，但是我希望你能学会我们的行为方式。我将注意你。现在，可以提问了。

text: 很好，还需要问些什么？
source_text: 很好，还需要问些什么？

text: 在山脉的深处，他说的不是很具体。
source_text: 在山脉的深处，他说的不是很具体。

text: 真糟糕，我能再问你一些问题吗？
source_text: 真糟糕，我能再问你一些问题吗？

text: 那北面呢？
source_text: 那北面呢？

text: 继续。
source_text: 继续。

text: 好，提问吧。
source_text: 好，提问吧。

text: 当然。
source_text: 当然。

text: 说话。
source_text: 说话。

text: 我的直觉告诉我东面有一小股的军事力量而北面才是大规模的。因为没有侦察兵从北面回来，元老们什么信息都没有收集到。我只能眼巴巴的看着确做不了任何事。
source_text: 我的直觉告诉我东面有一小股的军事力量而北面才是大规模的。因为没有侦察兵从北面回来，元老们什么信息都没有收集到。我只能眼巴巴的看着确做不了任何事。

text: 好吧，我将尽力而为。
source_text: 好吧，我将尽力而为。

text: 为什么你不做些事情？
source_text: 为什么你不做些事情？

text: 我有点糊涂了，我做不了。
source_text: 我有点糊涂了，我做不了。

text: 关于那个我有点信息。
source_text: 关于那个我有点信息。

text: 哈勃城的商人们告诉我，商队在去北面的路上消失了。我认为在山里有股军队。但是，元老们认为除非我们有肯定的证据否则不会采取行动的。
source_text: 哈勃城的商人们告诉我，商队在去北面的路上消失了。我认为在山里有股军队。但是，元老们认为除非我们有肯定的证据否则不会采取行动的。

text: 他们在哪里消失的？
source_text: 他们在哪里消失的？

text: 你不就是最高元老吗？你为什么不做一些事情？
source_text: 你不就是最高元老吗？你为什么不做一些事情？

text: 你什么行动都没采取？
source_text: 你什么行动都没采取？

text: 关于那个我有点信息。
source_text: 关于那个我有点信息。

text: 我得到的信息是，商队消失于东面山区的南部。我猜想哈勃城的商人们可能会提供更多的信息给你。
source_text: 我得到的信息是，商队消失于东面山区的南部。我猜想哈勃城的商人们可能会提供更多的信息给你。

text: 谢谢。如果可以的话，我有一些问题要问。
source_text: 谢谢。如果可以的话，我有一些问题要问。

text: 谢谢。稍后我和你谈谈。
source_text: 谢谢。稍后我和你谈谈。

text: 关于那个我有点信息。
source_text: 关于那个我有点信息。

text: 回头见。新加入者，对于一个外来者而言你还不赖。
source_text: 回头见。新加入者，对于一个外来者而言你还不赖。

text: 再见，新加入者。
source_text: 再见，新加入者。

text: 再见！
source_text: 再见！

text: 我在这个封闭的空间里长大。你能想象你的一生都在这个小地方里渡过, 然后不得不走到外面的世界去吗？
source_text: 我在这个封闭的空间里长大。你能想象你的一生都在这个小地方里渡过, 然后不得不走到外面的世界去吗？

text: 其实我也……
source_text: 其实我也……

text: 我想我逃脱不了成为你的侦察兵的命运了。
source_text: 我想我逃脱不了成为你的侦察兵的命运了。

text: 正是因为他们出不去，所以我要去干这个脏活，不行！
source_text: 正是因为他们出不去，所以我要去干这个脏活，不行！

text: 现在你知道这些情况了。为了生存，我们需要像你这样了解外面的外来者。
source_text: 现在你知道这些情况了。为了生存，我们需要像你这样了解外面的外来者。

text: 好吧，我干了。
source_text: 好吧，我干了。

text: 我自己有点小麻烦，我闪人。
source_text: 我自己有点小麻烦，我闪人。

text: 嗯……正如我所料，我们不会在一个不愿意奉献的人身上浪费时间。现在，你要么为我们工作，要么滚蛋！
source_text: 嗯……正如我所料，我们不会在一个不愿意奉献的人身上浪费时间。现在，你要么为我们工作，要么滚蛋！

text: 好吧，如果你这样说的话，我就干了。
source_text: 好吧，如果你这样说的话，我就干了。

text: 今天是个散步的好天气。
source_text: 今天是个散步的好天气。

text: 这是你的选择。别后悔。
source_text: 这是你的选择。别后悔。

text: 什么？那是我们之所以存在、我们之所以生活的原因，那是理想。只要你继续和我们在一起，也许你就能理解。
source_text: 什么？那是我们之所以存在、我们之所以生活的原因，那是理想。只要你继续和我们在一起，也许你就能理解。

text: 哦，你们究竟在做什么？
source_text: 哦，你们究竟在做什么？

text: 关于这个我不太肯定。
source_text: 关于这个我不太肯定。

text: 我们主要的目的是为了生存。研究员抄写武器的旧式图纸并设计出新的武器，骑士根据图纸制造枪。外面世界的大多数的枪都来自我们。
source_text: 我们主要的目的是为了生存。研究员抄写武器的旧式图纸并设计出新的武器，骑士根据图纸制造枪。外面世界的大多数的枪都来自我们。

text: 你和哈勃城贸易枪支？
source_text: 你和哈勃城贸易枪支？

text: 就这些？
source_text: 就这些？

text: 有道理。我需要问的一些其他的事。
source_text: 有道理。我需要问的一些其他的事。

text: 这是我们获得补给的方式。
source_text: 这是我们获得补给的方式。

text: 好吧，我知道了。另外有些问题我想问一下。
source_text: 好吧，我知道了。另外有些问题我想问一下。

text: 好吧。我现在要离开了。
source_text: 好吧。我现在要离开了。

text: 我猜我还是不太清楚。
source_text: 我猜我还是不太清楚。

text: 就这些？这是非常的重要的。这对我们的生存是非常重要。
source_text: 就这些？这是非常的重要的。这对我们的生存是非常重要。

text: 不管怎样，我需要问一些问题。
source_text: 不管怎样，我需要问一些问题。

text: 嗯，这是愚蠢的。
source_text: 嗯，这是愚蠢的。

text: 好吧。谢谢。我现在要离开了。
source_text: 好吧。谢谢。我现在要离开了。

text: 那么你需要学会肯定。如果你不肯定，将会使你被干掉。
source_text: 那么你需要学会肯定。如果你不肯定，将会使你被干掉。

text: 我知道的越多，我越肯定。
source_text: 我知道的越多，我越肯定。

text: 我没有时间长篇大论的讲故事。这里，我们从小就是看这个长大的。
source_text: 我没有时间长篇大论的讲故事。这里，我们从小就是看这个长大的。

text: 在哈勃城有个关于失踪商队的谣言，而且在东面的山里有股军队在壮大。
source_text: 在哈勃城有个关于失踪商队的谣言，而且在东面的山里有股军队在壮大。

text: 好。
source_text: 好。

text: 什么军队？
source_text: 什么军队？

text: 失踪的商队是怎么回事？
source_text: 失踪的商队是怎么回事？

text: 关于那个我有点信息。
source_text: 关于那个我有点信息。

text: 我又不是收藏消息的人。
source_text: 我又不是收藏消息的人。

text: 呃……很高兴又见到你，新加入者。事情进展的顺利？
source_text: 呃……很高兴又见到你，新加入者。事情进展的顺利？

text: 相当的好。我能问你几个问题吗？
source_text: 相当的好。我能问你几个问题吗？

text: 呃，实际上，真令人厌烦。
source_text: 呃，实际上，真令人厌烦。

text: 是的，谢谢，但是我必须走了。
source_text: 是的，谢谢，但是我必须走了。

text: 抱歉，我们不是你习惯的那样，但是你也应该表现出一些自律。
source_text: 抱歉，我们不是你习惯的那样，但是你也应该表现出一些自律。

text: 抱歉，我可以问你一些问题吗？
source_text: 抱歉，我可以问你一些问题吗？

text: 为什么？这个地方是个笑话？
source_text: 为什么？这个地方是个笑话？

text: 我必须走了，再见。
source_text: 我必须走了，再见。

text: 你他妈的现在想干什么？
source_text: 你他妈的现在想干什么？

text: 我想要知道一个白痴为什么能掌管这里。
source_text: 我想要知道一个白痴为什么能掌管这里。

text: 我需要问一些问题。
source_text: 我需要问一些问题。

text: 别介意，谢谢。
source_text: 别介意，谢谢。

text: 你发现了什么？
source_text: 你发现了什么？

text: 抱歉，没有任何进展。
source_text: 抱歉，没有任何进展。

text: 哈勃城的商队是被巨大的、绿色的变种人俘虏的。他们正在集结一支军队。
source_text: 哈勃城的商队是被巨大的、绿色的变种人俘虏的。他们正在集结一支军队。

text: 在北面有一支被叫做主教的人控制的大规模的军队。
source_text: 在北面有一支被叫做主教的人控制的大规模的军队。

text: 你见到他们了？这可能会说服元老们采取一些措施。我要忙这件事情去了。谢谢。
source_text: 你见到他们了？这可能会说服元老们采取一些措施。我要忙这件事情去了。谢谢。

text: 嗯……他集结军队有什么计划？
source_text: 嗯……他集结军队有什么计划？

text: 他打算征服兄弟会，哈勃城，迦克镇……每一个人。
source_text: 他打算征服兄弟会，哈勃城，迦克镇……每一个人。

text: 这个信息你要多少报酬？
source_text: 这个信息你要多少报酬？

text: 终于有了让这将元老们行动的证据了。我们将加固我们的城堡，出其不意地击溃那些该死的变种人。
source_text: 终于有了让这将元老们行动的证据了。我们将加固我们的城堡，出其不意地击溃那些该死的变种人。

text: 不是的！你不明白。他们把人变成变种人来扩充他们的军队。
source_text: 不是的！你不明白。他们把人变成变种人来扩充他们的军队。

text: 好吧。
source_text: 好吧。

text: 所以？
source_text: 所以？

text: 所以，当他们到达这里的时候，他们将不可阻挡。而且他们象你们一样拥有先进的武器。你根本没有机会。
source_text: 所以，当他们到达这里的时候，他们将不可阻挡。而且他们象你们一样拥有先进的武器。你根本没有机会。

text: 好吧。也许稳守是个好的选择。
source_text: 好吧。也许稳守是个好的选择。

text: 你的替代方案是什么？
source_text: 你的替代方案是什么？

text: 帮助我进攻主教的基地。我知道他在哪里。
source_text: 帮助我进攻主教的基地。我知道他在哪里。

text: 嗯，这个计划还可以，让我去说服那些元老。我不敢保证成功，但我尽力。
source_text: 嗯，这个计划还可以，让我去说服那些元老。我不敢保证成功，但我尽力。

text: 现在，出去。我还有事情要做。
source_text: 现在，出去。我还有事情要做。

text: 你的原则和立场很有问题啊。
source_text: 你的原则和立场很有问题啊。

text: 想要我有立场，给我500个瓶盖，不干就拉倒。
source_text: 想要我有立场，给我500个瓶盖，不干就拉倒。

text: 哦，耶，好吧，我会告诉你的。他打算征服所有的人和事。
source_text: 哦，耶，好吧，我会告诉你的。他打算征服所有的人和事。

text: 我接受你的条件，我们需要信息来拯救性命。
source_text: 我接受你的条件，我们需要信息来拯救性命。

text: 很简单。他把人类变成变种人，他拥有先进的武器。他打算征服一切。
source_text: 很简单。他把人类变成变种人，他拥有先进的武器。他打算征服一切。

text: 如果他成功了，希望你能找到个地方花你那些钱。
source_text: 如果他成功了，希望你能找到个地方花你那些钱。

text: 好吧，一毛不给你怎么样！警卫！让这个傻瓜滚蛋。上帝保佑！没有你的帮忙我们照样保卫兄弟会。
source_text: 好吧，一毛不给你怎么样！警卫！让这个傻瓜滚蛋。上帝保佑！没有你的帮忙我们照样保卫兄弟会。

text: 你在做什么？把那个放下来，现在把他放下来！
source_text: 你在做什么？把那个放下来，现在把他放下来！

text: 就这样！警卫，把这个傻瓜带走！
source_text: 就这样！警卫，把这个傻瓜带走！

text: 嘿、嘿、嘿、嘿！别动！住手！马上住手！
source_text: 嘿、嘿、嘿、嘿！别动！住手！马上住手！

text: 正如我说过的……
source_text: 正如我说过的……

text: 我说过……
source_text: 我说过……

text: 我没有重复的习惯。竖起耳朵给我听好。
source_text: 我没有重复的习惯。竖起耳朵给我听好。

text: 好像我已经告诉过你了。你不知道不是我的错。
source_text: 好像我已经告诉过你了。你不知道不是我的错。

text: 你现在就在这里啊。如果想听长故事，去找弗蕾。
source_text: 你现在就在这里啊。如果想听长故事，去找弗蕾。

text: 马蒂雅是我的助手。
source_text: 马蒂雅是我的助手。

text: 哦，虽然他想当一名研究员，但他还只是一个乖乖宝。
source_text: 哦，虽然他想当一名研究员，但他还只是一个乖乖宝。

text: 弗蕾是研究员的主管。她经常在图书馆里，她爱聊天。
source_text: 弗蕾是研究员的主管。她经常在图书馆里，她爱聊天。

text: 我们把武器的说明书和历史保存在那里。
source_text: 我们把武器的说明书和历史保存在那里。

text: 隆伯斯来这里很长一段时间了，他有点死板，但绝对是一个好战士。
source_text: 隆伯斯来这里很长一段时间了，他有点死板，但绝对是一个好战士。

text: 嘿嘿。一个善良、英俊和正直的男人。高级元老的职责是在元老会议上斡旋。你看，两年前我被说服干这岗位。如果我当时知道是这样……
source_text: 嘿嘿。一个善良、英俊和正直的男人。高级元老的职责是在元老会议上斡旋。你看，两年前我被说服干这岗位。如果我当时知道是这样……

text: 你看，他们有四个，总是难以达成共识。就是是否用尿壶撒尿这样的事情也不能敲定。
source_text: 你看，他们有四个，总是难以达成共识。就是是否用尿壶撒尿这样的事情也不能敲定。

text: 这就是你现在的头衔啊，新兵要训练，以后学习成为骑士或者研究员。
source_text: 这就是你现在的头衔啊，新兵要训练，以后学习成为骑士或者研究员。

text: 嗯，研究员们记录下武器的设计副本。从我爷爷那时候起的所有信息资料我们都有记录。有时研究员会灵光一现，为一个武器提出一个新的主意。呵呵，并不经常出现。他们都归弗蕾管。
source_text: 嗯，研究员们记录下武器的设计副本。从我爷爷那时候起的所有信息资料我们都有记录。有时研究员会灵光一现，为一个武器提出一个新的主意。呵呵，并不经常出现。他们都归弗蕾管。

text: 骑士制造武器。如果他够棒的话，一个骑士可以晋级为游侠、元老等等。现在隆伯斯是骑士的头。
source_text: 骑士制造武器。如果他够棒的话，一个骑士可以晋级为游侠、元老等等。现在隆伯斯是骑士的头。
